Quotes

Prices are quoted per order and depend on the garment, quantity and decoration. A quote is an estimate, not an order. Your order is confirmed once you approve your proof and any payment terms on your invoice.

Proofs and approval

Before anything is produced, we send a digital proof showing colors, placement and sizing. Please review it carefully, including spelling, names, numbers and sizes. Once you approve a proof, we produce your order to match it. Colors on screens can differ slightly from finished ink and thread colors.

Changes and cancellations

You can change or cancel an order at no charge any time before you approve your proof. Once production begins, we may not be able to make changes or cancel, because every item is made to order.

Your artwork

By sending us a logo, design, name or other artwork, you confirm that you own it or have permission to use it, and that it doesn't infringe anyone else's trademark, copyright or other rights. You are responsible for any claims arising from artwork you provide. We may decline any order that we believe infringes someone's rights or that we find offensive.

Turnaround and delivery

Standard production is about two weeks after proof approval, plus shipping, and rush production may be available. If you give us a hard deadline and we accept it when quoting, we will deliver on time or make it right. Otherwise, timelines are estimates and can be affected by supplier stock, carrier delays and events outside our control.

Our happiness guarantee

If your order has a misprint or defect, or doesn't match your approved proof, contact us as soon as you receive it and we will reprint the affected items or refund them. Because every item is custom-made, we can't accept returns or exchanges for items that match the approved proof, including for size or change of mind.
